ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Bloodhound/Sharphound Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects command line parameters used by Bloodhound and Sharphound hack tools

sequences.query: ((process_product = RGX(".*SharpHound.*") OR process_description = RGX(".*SharpHound.*") OR (process_company = RGX(".*SpecterOps.*") OR process_company = RGX(".*evil\\ corp.*")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Bloodhound\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\SharpHound\\\.exe.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-CollectionMethod\\ All\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-CollectionMethods\\ Session\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-Loop\\ \\-\\-Loopduration\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-PortScanTimeout\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ \\-c\\ All\\ \\-d\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Bloodhound.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-BloodHoundData.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-JsonFolder\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ZipFileName\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ DCOnly\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-NoSaveCache\\ .*")))
